confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few web searches: one Takayama listing (Kirin medium bottle at JPY 680), chain-cafe latte and cappuccino ranges (about JPY 450-650), izakaya beer and wine ranges, and one Kyoto/Osaka cocktail menu. Searches found no Takayama-specific cappuccino price, so coffee is inferred from chains. Cocktail and wine are weakly sourced; cocktail was set from the regional bar menus and wine was set relative to local beer prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Takayama tourism context. They are not based on inspected booking pages or current listings, and peak-season rates may be higher. The FX observation (2026-11-18, 0.6720) came from a third-party summary that cites the RBA feed. I could not open or verify the official rba.gov.au table, so the source_url is the RBA exchange-rates page and the value needs confirmation. Other searches returned conflicting or stale FX figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Japanese mid-sized heritage tourist towns with similar restaurant and guesthouse pricing, adjusted for Takayama's higher accommodation demand in peak seasons. Food and drink anchors use national chain and izakaya price ranges where city-specific data was missing.
